testEmpiricalProof_ResetFlappingDefect().notice: Proof 1: Verify the Reset Flapping Defect in ResetController.sol. When spot price increases to $40, an upward reset triggers and executes. Due to beta * P_0 double-counting, in the very next check at the SAME price $40, NAV_B evaluates to 0.25 <= H_d ($0.25), immediately triggering a spurious DOWNWARD reset.

testEmpiricalProof_SecondaryTrancheRebas.notice: Proof 2: Verify Secondary Tranche Rebase Disconnect & Unbacked Wealth Extraction. Splitting 100 Class A into 100 A' and 100 B', experiencing an upward reset, and merging back mints 100 raw Class A which is now worth 150 nominal Class A (+50% free tokens).

testEmpiricalProof_TrancheSplitterTwoToO.notice: Proof 3: Verify 2:1 Accounting Discrepancy in TrancheSplitter.sol. Burning 1 unit of Class A ($1.00) mints 1 unit of A' ($1.00) AND 1 unit of B' ($1.00), creating $2.00 in nominal claims from $1.00 in collateral.
